newsitem.title: USA: Duchess of York to meet Hollywood execs this week.
newsitem.headline: Duchess of York to meet Hollywood execs this week.

text.p: Britain's Duchess of York, Sarah Ferguson, will meet with Hollywood executives this week to discuss the possibility of a television show, her spokesman said on Monday.
"The Duchess is going to meet with some executives from networks and studios and they are going to have discussions," said Jeff Schneider of public relations firm Howard Rubenstein.

"They they are generally interested in having her do her own show. Obviously, there are a limited number of television formats," he said, adding that reports the Duchess would be offered a daytime talk show were premature.
The Sunday Times in London, citing sources close to the talks, said the Duchess was about to be offered a daytime chat show on U.S. television.

It said proposals would be presented to the Duchess, nicknamed "Fergie," at the Los Angeles offices of International Creative Management (ICM) agency Wednesday and Thursday by senior executives from six media groups.
ICM officials were not immediately available. Schneider declined to specify the time or locations of the meetings. "It's a private schedule," he said.

Schneider said Ferguson would appear this week on the Tonight Show. He said Ferguson's successful appearances on several shows last month, including PrimeTime Live with Diane Sawyer, the Oprah Winfrey and Larry King shows, ignited interest among the studios.
"The success that she enjoyed on those shows and the very high ratings that she pulled sparked a keen interest among Hollywood big shots," Schneider said.
